control_families.text: input#first-name-input, #last-name-input (autocomplete given-name/family-name, aria-required=true); label element <label for=id id=id-label> with text '<Label>*' when required.
control_families.email: input[type=email]#email-input and #confirm-email-input (both required) — email must be entered twice.
control_families.city_typeahead: input#spl-form-element_10 role=combobox aria-haspopup=listbox 'City' (required on sr-01/02, optional sr-03); async suggestions, no static list.
control_families.phone: div[role=group] 'Phone number' containing button[role=combobox]#spl-form-element_12 aria-label 'Country code' (listbox with search 'Search by country/region or code') + input[type=tel]#spl-form-element_5.
control_families.avatar: button[data-test=avatar-browse] 'Upload profile image' + input[type=file] accept images (optional).
control_families.file_autofill: spl-dropzone[data-test=apply-with-resume-container] inside <oc-apply-with-resume>: input[type=file]#file-input, label 'Choose a file or drop it here' — this is the AUTOFILL PARSER at the top of the form.
control_families.file_resume: spl-dropzone[data-test=resume-upload] under <oc-resume-upload> with section title 'Resume' (data-test=section-title): second input[type=file]#file-input (same id!) — this is the RESUME ATTACHMENT. Both accept the same very long list (.doc, .dot, .rmr, .rsm, .resume, .oxps, .pdf, .p7s, .ai, .rtf, .pages, .gdoc, .gslides, .xls, .xlsm, .pub, .msg, .ppt, .wps, .ods, .odt, .pptx, .ppsx, .xlsx, .docx, .dotx, .sxw, .wpd, .abw, .mp3, .m4a, .wav, .psd, .eml, .ical, .ics, .ifb, .icalendar, .ics_response, .csv, .txt, .text, .vcf, .mp4, .mov, .bmp, .gif, .jfif, .jpeg, .jpg, .png, .tif, .tiff, .webp).
control_families.textarea: textarea#hiring-manager-message-input 'Let the company know about your interest working there' (optional free text).
control_families.next: button containing span 'Next' at the bottom (advances to gated step; not final submit).

blockers.detail: All controls live in nested shadow roots; querySelector from document sees nothing. Runtime must traverse shadowRoot (extract_form.js v5 qsaDeep) or use opencli state (which already pierces shadow).
Screening questions unobserved; require typing to reach.
Two input#file-input (autofill vs resume). Bind via ancestor data-test (apply-with-resume-container vs resume-upload).

runtime_observations: nearest_heading_before is unreliable across shadow boundaries (compareDocumentPosition); use ancestor_context/preceding_text in controls.json.
state.txt is very large (~7.5k lines) because the country-code listbox options are all in the DOM.
